user.title: Set up Laundry Assistant
user.description: Which appliance do you want to track? Washing machines and tumble dryers have different power signatures and are set up separately.

washer.title: Washing machine
washer.description: Choose the sensor that reports the plug's active power in watts. It has to update at least every 30 seconds - a slower interval misses the spin cycle entirely.

dryer.title: Tumble dryer
dryer.description: Choose the sensor that reports the plug's active power in watts. It has to update at least every 30 seconds - a slower interval misses the cool-down phase entirely.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already tracked by another appliance.

init.title: Reconfigure appliance
init.description: Change which entities this appliance is tracked by. Thresholds, history and settings are kept.

set_price.name: Set price
set_price.description: Sets the electricity price used to cost a cycle.

entry_id.name: Appliance
entry_id.description: The entry_id of the appliance, from the phase sensor's attributes.

currency.name: Currency
currency.description: Currency symbol shown next to the cost, e.g. EUR.

set_reminder.name: Set reminder
set_reminder.description: Configures the reminder for laundry left in the drum.

entry_id.name: Appliance
entry_id.description: The entry_id of the appliance, from the phase sensor's attributes.

delay_minutes.name: Delay
delay_minutes.description: Minutes after the cycle ends before the first reminder.

max_repeats.name: Maximum repeats
max_repeats.description: How often to remind before giving up.

set_notify_target.name: Set notification target
set_notify_target.description: Chooses which notify service receives reminders and warnings.

entry_id.name: Appliance
entry_id.description: The entry_id of the appliance, from the phase sensor's attributes.

target.name: Target
target.description: Name of the notify service, e.g. mobile_app_my_phone. Leave empty to switch notifications off.

set_thresholds.name: Set band thresholds
set_thresholds.description: Sets the power band edges in watts. They must increase strictly from standby to high.

entry_id.name: Appliance
entry_id.description: The entry_id of the appliance, from the phase sensor's attributes.

start_calibration.name: Start calibration
start_calibration.description: Records the next few complete runs and proposes band thresholds from them. Detection keeps using the current thresholds meanwhile.

entry_id.name: Appliance
entry_id.description: The entry_id of the appliance, from the phase sensor's attributes.

cancel_calibration.name: Cancel calibration
cancel_calibration.description: Stops recording and discards the collected samples.

entry_id.name: Appliance
entry_id.description: The entry_id of the appliance, from the phase sensor's attributes.

apply_calibration.name: Apply calibration
apply_calibration.description: Adopts the proposed thresholds. Fails if no proposal is ready.

entry_id.name: Appliance
entry_id.description: The entry_id of the appliance, from the phase sensor's attributes.

dismiss_reminder.name: Dismiss reminder
dismiss_reminder.description: Cancels a pending reminder for laundry left in the drum.

entry_id.name: Appliance
entry_id.description: The entry_id of the appliance, from the phase sensor's attributes.

clear_history.name: Clear history
clear_history.description: Deletes all stored runs. The remaining-time estimate has to relearn afterwards, and the weekly totals restart at zero.

entry_id.name: Appliance
entry_id.description: The entry_id of the appliance, from the phase sensor's attributes.

set_anomaly_detection.name: Set deviation warnings
set_anomaly_detection.description: Enables comparing each finished run against the appliance's history, and sets how far a phase may stray before it is reported.

entry_id.name: Appliance
entry_id.description: The entry_id of the appliance, from the phase sensor's attributes.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether to compare finished runs against the history.

factor.name: Factor
factor.description: How many times its usual duration a phase may take before it is reported.

dismiss_anomalies.name: Dismiss deviation warnings
dismiss_anomalies.description: Clears the findings from the last run.

entry_id.name: Appliance
entry_id.description: The entry_id of the appliance, from the phase sensor's attributes.

set_program_name.name: Name a program
set_program_name.description: Gives a recognised program a name, e.g. "Cotton 60".

entry_id.name: Appliance
entry_id.description: The entry_id of the appliance, from the phase sensor's attributes.

program_id.name: Program
program_id.description: The program id, listed in the phase sensor's "programs" attribute.

set_solar.name: Set solar surplus sources
set_solar.description: Points the appliance at a solar production sensor and, optionally, a house consumption sensor, so it can tell when a cycle would run on surplus.

entry_id.name: Appliance
entry_id.description: The entry_id of the appliance, from the phase sensor's attributes.

solar_entity.name: Solar production
solar_entity.description: Sensor reporting current solar production. Leave empty to switch the suggestion off.

consumption_entity.name: House consumption
consumption_entity.description: Sensor reporting what the house is drawing, so surplus can be worked out.

feed_in_tariff.name: Feed-in tariff
feed_in_tariff.description: What one exported kilowatt hour earns. The saving is the difference to the price paid.

set_chain_to_dryer.name: Chain to the dryer
set_chain_to_dryer.description: Adds a note to the finished reminder when a dryer set up in this integration is free.

entry_id.name: Appliance
entry_id.description: The entry_id of the appliance, from the phase sensor's attributes.

set_price_sensor.name: Set dynamic price source
set_price_sensor.description: Points the appliance at a price sensor (e.g. Tibber). Leave empty to use the fixed price.

entry_id.name: Appliance
entry_id.description: The entry_id of the appliance, from the phase sensor's attributes.

price_entity.name: Price sensor
price_entity.description: Sensor reporting the current price per kWh.

reset_consumable_counter.name: Reset consumable counter
reset_consumable_counter.description: Resets the count of finished cycles since the last reset (detergent, decalcification).

entry_id.name: Appliance
entry_id.description: The entry_id of the appliance, from the phase sensor's attributes.

plan_ready_by.name: Plan ready-by time
plan_ready_by.description: Stores when the laundry should be ready; the latest start is derived from the learned duration.

entry_id.name: Appliance
entry_id.description: The entry_id of the appliance, from the phase sensor's attributes.

ready_by.name: Ready by
ready_by.description: ISO datetime when the cycle should be done. Leave empty to clear the plan.
